song.title: Ten Miles Past the Water Tower
song.theme: leaving a small town for good

lines: I loaded up the truck at dawn
and left the screen door swinging shut
the fields were silver, still half gone
the tank was full, the choice was cut
Town, I loved you nice and slow
but I've got somewhere else to go
these roads all lead away from home
so I'll just have to learn to roam
My mother's roses climbed the fence
she waved until I turned the bend
I told myself it made more sense
to leave before the story'd end
Town, I loved you nice and slow
but I've got somewhere else to go
these roads all lead away from home
so I'll just have to learn to roam
If you drive out past the tower
you will see the house is dark tonight
you will see how green it is this hour
and know I left with all my might
Town, I loved you nice and slow
but I've got somewhere else to go
these roads all lead away from home
so I'll just have to learn to roam
